# khulnasoft_secure_ai_integration (Resource)

Manages the Secure AI integration settings in Khulnasoft. This is a singleton resource — only one instance can exist. It configures which AI security provider (Akamai or Khulnasoft) is active and its connection parameters.

~> **Note:** This resource manages a singleton settings object. Destroying it only removes it from Terraform state; the settings persist on the server.

~> **Note:** The server clears sensitive fields (`api_key`, `id`) on read. The provider preserves user-provided values from state to avoid perpetual diffs.

~> **Note:** The Khulnasoft provider's `api_key`, `id`, and `mode` are controlled server-side via the `KHULNASOFT_AI_TOKEN` and `KHULNASOFT_AI_ID` environment variables. Values set in Terraform for the `khulnasoft` block are overridden by the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "khulnasoft_secure_ai_integration" "example" {
  selected_ui = "akamai"

  akamai {
    api_key = var.akamai_api_key
    id      = "akamai-provider-id"
    enabled = true
    mode    = "external"
  }
}
```

## Import

The Secure AI integration can be imported using the fixed ID `secure_ai`:

```shell
terraform import khulnasoft_secure_ai_integration.example secure_ai
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `selected_ui` (String) The selected UI provider for Secure AI (e.g. `akamai`, `khulnasoft`).

### Optional

- `akamai` (Block List, Max: 1) Akamai Secure AI provider configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--akamai))
- `khulnasoft` (Block List, Max: 1) Khulnasoft Secure AI provider configuration. Note: the server overrides Khulnasoft provider parameters from environment variables (`KHULNASOFT_AI_TOKEN`, `KHULNASOFT_AI_ID`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--khulnasoft))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--akamai"></a>
### Nested Schema for `akamai`

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for the Secure AI provider.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this Secure AI provider is enabled.
- `id` (String) Identifier for the Secure AI provider.
- `mode` (String) Mode of the Secure AI provider (`external` or `internal`).


<a id="nestedblock--khulnasoft"></a>
### Nested Schema for `khulnasoft`

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for the Secure AI provider. Server-controlled via `KHULNASOFT_AI_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this Secure AI provider is enabled.
- `id` (String) Identifier for the Secure AI provider. Server-controlled via `KHULNASOFT_AI_ID` environment variable.
- `mode` (String) Mode of the Secure AI provider (`external` or `internal`). Server-controlled.
